title: eval or dynamic source constructing a command from a variable
purpose: Prevent executing text you (or another component) did not hand-author, because eval/build-a-command-string-from-a-variable turns data into code with no bounds.
trigger: Code uses eval, or sources/maintains a file whose path or content is provided by a variable or $( ) (dynamic source), or composes a command line by string interpolation and pipes it to sh. eval built from a var or $( ) is unambiguously the intent to run dynamic text.
correct: Prefer direct execution of a known command and argument arrays. Where you genuinely must interpret controlled text, whitelist allowed forms and run them via the bounded mechanism; never eval unbounded data.
evidence_note: Grounded in docs/PLAN_ADAPTER_CONTRACT.md, which flags eval/dynamic source/piped curl|sh as needs_review, and in the provider data-never-shell doctrine.
return_semantics: A reference rule page; shown for LLM author guidance, not executed by rules check.
